nodes.label: HAG-54 Report: Accounts Slice Dead-Control Wiring
nodes.rationale: 18 alert() stubs across 5 files were replaced because the old pattern gave operators zero feedback: the success path showed nothing while the failure path only alerted. Every success path now confirms inline (toasts in Accounts.jsx, a new matching top-centre toast on the reconciliation pages, a green/rose result card on CustomerInvoicePage, an inline rose message in InvoiceForm) and every failure path displays the backend's own message (err.response?.data?.message). Backend-owned defects found but not fixed: POST /accounts/expense is registered in accountsRoutes.js yet the running build answers 'Endpoint not found'; POST/PUT/DELETE on petty-cash and gst-returns return 501 because those are derived read-only views over the v4 payments table; GET /accounts/bank-ledger returns empty rows, so ReconciliationDataPage has nothing meaningful to show.

nodes.label: api-routes.json (445-route registry)
nodes.rationale: Live route registry at Maa-Baglamkhi-Resort-Backend/test/reports/api-routes.json (445 registered routes; 62 /inventory* routes, all PASS). It is the reference the slices grep to split 'backend is missing the route' from 'frontend is calling the right name and the report is stale': GET /api/invoice/by-booking/:bookingId and GET /api/invoice/:id are absent from it yet exist, declared in src/routes/InvoiceRoutes.js and mounted at /api/invoice in app.js, so the registry needs a regenerate, not a frontend change.

nodes.label: src/pages/Accounts.jsx (accounts hub page)
nodes.rationale: Carries 10 of the 18 replaced alert stubs and the shared module-entry helpers over POST/PUT/DELETE /accounts/{petty-cash,gst-returns,vendor-payments,purchase-orders,payroll,profit-centers,bank-ledger}. Its six inline toasts (top-centre, 4 s) were extended with success toasts for entry saved/updated/deleted, income added, expense added and invoice generated; failure toasts carry the backend message and the income/expense and invoice modals now close on success instead of staying open.

nodes.label: src/pages/ReconciliationDataPage.jsx
nodes.rationale: 3 alert stubs replaced with calls to POST/PUT/DELETE /accounts/bank-ledger; since no toast existed on this page, a matching top-centre toast (emerald/rose, FaCheckCircle/FaExclamationCircle, same style as Accounts.jsx) was added. Ledger rows are re-fetched and the accountsUpdated event still fires, so the table re-sorts before the toast disappears. It renders, but the endpoint returns empty rows (entry_date, amount, debit, credit, statement_ref, statement_date, notes all empty/zero), so there is nothing meaningful to show.

nodes.label: src/pages/BankReconciliation.jsx
nodes.rationale: 2 alert stubs replaced; like ReconciliationDataPage.jsx it had no toast of its own, so the same emerald/rose top-centre toast style as Accounts.jsx was added for POST /accounts/reconciliation/match and /unmatch, and the ledger re-fetch plus accountsUpdated event re-sort the table before the toast disappears.

nodes.label: src/pages/CustomerInvoicePage.jsx
nodes.rationale: 3 alert stubs around POST /accounts/settle-pending-bill (2 missing input guards) replaced with a green result card under the invoice showing 'Payment saved. Invoice balance is now settled.' or the outstanding balance taken from the balance field the endpoint returns, plus a rose validation/error card for the two missing-input cases and server errors. The settlement panel disappears on its own once paymentStatus flips to paid because the invoice is reloaded.

nodes.label: src/components/Accounts/forms/InvoiceForm.jsx
nodes.rationale: 3 alert stubs around POST /invoices/create and PUT /invoices/update/:id (2 missing input guards) replaced with an inline rose message above the action buttons, so the form no longer closes the browser dialog and loses the operator's typing when validation or the server call fails.
